content.title: 76ers vs. Heat: Prediction, How to Watch for Free (3/30/26)
content.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (41–33) face the Miami Heat (39–35) today at Kaseya Center in Miami. The Sixers have won two straight and, with eight games remaining in the regular season, sit just a half-game out of the final automatic playoff spot and one game back of fifth place in the Eastern Conference. On Saturday, they overcame a 15-point deficit to defeat the Charlotte Hornets, 118–114, powered by a combined 81 points from their big three. Joel Embiid led the way with 29 points, and Paul George and Tyrese Maxey each scored 26, showcasing just how dominant Philadelphia can be as they near the postseason at full strength. Miami, meanwhile, has dropped two straight and seven out of its last eight games. They’re three games out of the final automatic playoff spot with seven games left in their regular season schedule. A play-in tournament berth is the most likely scenario for the Heat, who come in off a 135–118 loss to the Indiana Pacers — a team with the worst record in the NBA. With Norman Powell still sidelined, Tyler Herro led with 31 points, draining five 3-pointers. Jaime Jaquez Jr. added 17 in an efficient 26 minutes. But Miami once again struggled on defense, allowing the Pacers to shoot 58% from the field overall and 46% from downtown. Indiana’s opponents have scored 134 points or more in five out of its last seven games. Philadelphia’s improved health, scoring depth, and recent momentum give them the edge against a Miami team struggling on defense. Final Score Prediction: Philadelphia 76ers 130, Miami Heat 118 Injury Report Philadelphia 76ers Johni Broome — Out (Knee) Miami Heat Norman Powell — Out (Illness) Pelle Larsson — GTD (Triceps) Terry Rozier — Out How to Watch 76ers vs. Heat Tip-off for tonight’s 76ers-Heat game is set for 7:00 PM Eastern at the Kaseya Center in Miami.
